about: Every team power figure this record found, one row each: a measured change (before → after), a gain per step, or an account snapshot with the state of its growth systems. 'kind' is posted (the player's own figure), claimed (a figure stated without a measurement) or inferred (this record's arithmetic, with the basis in 'note'). 'approximate' marks a figure the post gives loosely, as a range whose midpoint is used, a question or an unclear kind of power; the note says which. Power in G (billions) as posted. Dates are post dates. From 2026-10-10 a row whose note starts 'damage, not power' measures a Guild Conquest score: its before/after are blank and delta_pct is the score's change.
